preconditions.expression: all(len(A[0]) == len(s) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in A have the same length.
No string in A is empty.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in A are lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(D) for D in possible_deletion_sets(A))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum size of a deletion set D such that after deleting columns in D from every string in A, each resulting string is lexicographically non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(all(A[i][j] <= A[i][j+1] for j in range(len(A[i])-1-len(D)) for i in range(len(A))) for D in possible_deletion_sets(A) if len(D) == return_value)
postconditions.description: For every valid deletion set D of size return_value, each resulting string in A is lexicographically non-decreasing after deletions.
